# pvecli ceph unset

Clear Ceph OSD flags, e.g. after a cluster shutdown or reboot.

```text
pvecli ceph unset FLAGS [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `FLAGS` | Flag(s), comma separated: noout,nobackfill. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
